answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 148112 Country: India Title: Can I pay my zakah before the period of one year completes? Question: Can I pay my zakah before the period of one year completes? Answer ID: 148112 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 466/419/H=5/1438) You may pay in advance, but calculate zakah on the completion of the year, if some amount remains unpaid, then pay it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
